zh.title: 印度航空墨爾本航線航班大幅成長四成四創紀錄
zh.summary: 印度航空德里至墨爾本航線航班增44%；投入客機提供每日波音777服務
body: 印度航空（Air India）在連接印度與澳洲的主要航線上提升營運規模，其航班數量顯著成長百分之四十四（44%），創下該條航線上的最新營運紀錄。
根據 Simple Flying 報導，此次營運調整主要集中於德里與墨爾本之間的航線連結。印度航空透過部署機型更大的寬體客機以及調高整體航班營運頻率，重塑該航線的服務結構。
在具體的客機安排方面，印度航空在德里至墨爾本航線上提供每日執飛的波音 777 客機服務，同時亦額外增加了波音 787 客機執飛的航班班次。

en.title: Air India Flights On Delhi-Melbourne Route Surge 44% To Set New Record
en.summary: Air India flight frequencies on Delhi-Melbourne route surge 44%; daily Boeing 777 service added
body: Air India has registered a 44 percent surge in flight operations on a key Australian route, setting a new record for flight frequency on the international corridor. The carrier's expanded capacity reflects an operational adjustment on services linking India and Australia.
According to Simple Flying, the expansion reshapes the flight link between Delhi and Melbourne. Air India is deploying larger widebody aircraft alongside extra service frequencies across the route.
The operational pattern on the Delhi-Melbourne route includes daily flights operated by Boeing 777 aircraft, supplemented by added services utilizing Boeing 787 widebody jets.

zh.title: 漢光42號演習 憲兵松山機場周邊執行反機降演練
zh.summary: 憲兵後備旅於松山機場周邊執行反機降作戰演練；封閉復北地下道並以空包彈模擬交戰
body: 國軍漢光42號實兵演習進入縱深防禦及持久作戰階段，憲兵後備旅於10日深夜至11日凌晨在松山機場周邊執行反機降作戰演練。軍方演習想定設定共軍掌握空中優勢，運用特工滲透破壞及無人機偵察襲擾，策應空中部隊於松山機場實施機降作戰，憲後旅步3營投入中層防護任務，與支援友軍共同執行反機降作戰。
憲兵於晚間10時許在復北地下道南北兩端入口設置6道阻絕，由外而內分別為紐澤西護欄、鋼刺蝟、蛇腹型鐵絲網、艾斯科防禦工事及橫停道路的遊覽車，並穿插安裝戰防雷。軍用遊覽車約晚間10時30分停靠民權東路五段與撫遠街交叉路口，封阻西向車道進行演練，東向道路維持通行。
駐守民權東路五段的憲兵於晚間11時47分左右開始發射空包彈，模擬與共軍交戰。現場官兵武器為T91戰鬥步槍、T75班用機槍，部分軍士官配T75K3手槍。第一波交戰於晚間11時50分左右爆發，模擬中共特工及零散兵力意圖經復北地下道穿越至大直橋進犯聯合作戰指揮中心。
憲兵228營無人機連出動無人機協助監偵，憲後旅步3營多數兵力駐守復北地下道南端出口，北端出口部署1個班兵力，周邊公寓大樓頂樓制高點亦有部署。隨著模擬敵軍遭到肅清，演訓約於凌晨0時30分左右結束。
憲兵指揮部表示，透過這次演練可驗證後備部隊動員編成、臨戰訓練及遂行防衛作戰能力，並強化友軍部隊協調及整合運用效能。

en.title: Han Kuang 42 Exercise: Military Police Conduct Counter-Air-Landing Drill Around Songshan Airport
en.summary: Military Police reserve brigade conducted counter-air-landing drill near Songshan Airport; Fubei underpass closed and blank rounds fired
body: The Han Kuang 42 live-troop exercise entered its defense-in-depth and sustained-operations phase, with the Military Police Reserve Brigade conducting a counter-air-landing drill near Songshan Airport from the night of August 10 into the early hours of August 11. According to the exercise scenario, enemy forces had gained air superiority and used agent infiltration, drone reconnaissance and harassment to support an air-landing assault on Songshan Airport. The Military Police Reserve Brigade's 3rd Infantry Battalion was deployed on mid-level protection missions alongside supporting friendly forces.

Military Police began setting up six layers of obstacles at both entrances of the Fubei underpass around 10 p.m., including Jersey barriers, steel hedgehogs, concertina wire, HESCO bastions, and a bus parked horizontally across the road, with anti-tank mines interspersed within the first five layers. A military bus was positioned at the intersection of Minquan East Road Section 5 and Fuyuan Street around 10:30 p.m., blocking the westbound lane for the drill while eastbound traffic continued.

Military Police stationed on Minquan East Road Section 5 began firing blank rounds at approximately 11:47 p.m. to simulate combat. Troops were armed with T91 combat rifles and T75 squad machine guns, with some officers carrying T75K3 pistols. The first wave of simulated engagement broke out around 11:50 p.m., simulating enemy agents and scattered forces attempting to cross through the Fubei underpass toward Dazhi Bridge to advance on the Joint Operations Command Center.

The Military Police 228th Battalion's drone company deployed unmanned aerial vehicles for reconnaissance support. The majority of the 3rd Infantry Battalion's forces were stationed at the south exit of the Fubei underpass, with one squad at the north exit and additional forces deployed at rooftop vantage points on surrounding apartment buildings. The drill concluded at approximately 12:30 a.m. after the simulated enemy forces were cleared.

The Military Police Command stated that the exercise verified the reserve units' mobilization formation, pre-combat training and defense-combat capabilities, while strengthening coordination and integrated employment efficiency with friendly forces.

zh.title: 泰國越捷航空B38M客機抵達桃園國際機場（TPE）
zh.summary: 泰國越捷航空B38M客機於2026/8/10桃園國際機場安全降落
body: 公開 ADS-B 觀測資料顯示，航空器 ICAO hex 為 885b44，註冊號為 HS-VZD，機型顯示名稱 Boeing 737 MAX 8。
呼號 TVJ566 所示，營運者 ICAO 為 TVJ、IATA 為 VZ，營運者名稱 Thai Vietjet Air（泰國越捷航空），所屬國家或地區為泰國。
確認抵達時間為 2026-08-10T23:20:03Z，抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground。
觀測由 Airplanes.live 與 ADSB.lol 兩個來源交叉確認，狀態為 confirmed_by_two_sources，有效觀測筆數為 2。
系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計，故此觀測屬少見組合。

The callsign TVJ566 indicates the operator ICAO TVJ, IATA VZ, operator name Thai Vietjet Air, based in Thailand.
